# Noel Earvin Piamonte

> Personal website of Noel Earvin Piamonte, a software engineer from Baguio City, Philippines. Currently a Software Engineer at Infor, building the Infor MSCM mobile app for Mobile Supply Chain Management. Outside work, he builds things for the web with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

This site is a living collection of professional work, personal projects, writing and curated interests. The content is mostly static, authored in MDX and generated with Next.js.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/): Introduction, work experience, certifications and featured content.
- [Portfolio](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/portfolio): Selected client projects built as an independent software developer.
- [Crafts](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/crafts): Personal projects, mostly open source and available on GitHub.
- [Blog](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/blog): Personal writing about work, life and everything in between.
- [Wtf-is](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/wtf-is): Personal glossary answering technical questions in plain language.
- [Kit](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/kit): Hardware, software and platforms used daily.
- [Playlist](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/playlist): Top Spotify tracks and movies/TV shows enjoyed.
- [Certifications](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/certifications): Professional certificates and credentials.

## Notable crafts

- [daylight](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/daylight): A Google Chrome extension for writing notes directly on the new tab page.
- [drownthesky](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/drownthesky): A React web app for browsing and listening to music.
- [ecdiff](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/ecdiff): An online diff/ compare tool for text.
- [Eclipse patch viewer](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/eclipse-patch-viewer): A helper for viewing Eclipse IDE patch files.
- [Freelancer.com helper](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/freelancer-com-helper): Browser extension enhancements for Freelancer.com.
- [Jira software tool](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/jira-software-tool): Utilities for working with Jira.
- [nbi.vercel.app](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/nbi.vercel.app): A small web app related to NBI clearance information.
- [Next.js + Tailwind CSS template](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/nextjs-tailwindcss-template): A starter template for Next.js projects using Tailwind CSS.
- [To-do list app demo](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/to-do-list-app-demo): A demo to-do list application.
- [Twitter stripped](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/twitter-stripped): A stripped-down Twitter/ X UI experiment.
- [Facebook stripped](https://www.earvinpiamonte.com/craft/facebook-stripped): A stripped-down Facebook UI experiment.
